newsitem.title: UK: NatWest shares advance as bid talk hots up.
newsitem.headline: NatWest shares advance as bid talk hots up.

text.p: Shares in National Westminster Bank Plc gained ground on Monday as market speculation about a possible takeover bid for the company hotted up.
NatWest's shares were up 15-1/2 pence at 826 by 0815 GMT.

After a flurry of weekend press reports that the bank is now in takeover play, a report in the Financial Times on Monday said NatWest had called on the Britain's Takeover Panel to force rival Barclays Plc to make "an unequivocal statement" on whether it planned a bid.
Speculation about NatWest's future was reignited by reports last week that the bank had made 90 million stg of derivatives losses at its investment banking arm over a two-year period.

This had followed NatWest making an approach to fellow British bank Abbey National Plc recently. Those talks never got off the ground, but NatWest has also been rumoured in a possible link with financial services giant Prudential Corporation.
Elsewhere in the sector on Monday, Lloyds TSB Group Plc was up 7-1/2p at 637-1/2 and Abbey National was up 5-1/2 at 837.
